connector.name: Aethyn Browser MCP
connector.registryDescription: Local Playwright browser through residential proxies - agent picks country + sticky identity
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package aethyn-browser-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the aethynio account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: AETHYN_USERNAME
env.description: Aethyn proxy username (e.g. aethyn-XXXXX). Omit if using a custom proxy via PROXY_*.

env.name: AETHYN_PASSWORD
env.description: Aethyn proxy password (or PROXY_PASSWORD for a custom proxy).

env.name: AETHYN_DEFAULT_TIER
env.description: Default proxy tier: premium (port 2099) or elite (port 5499).
